meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: on failure — falls back to Procol-native login if SSO fails
gaps: Configure inbound SAML 2.0 integration INT-003 with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping
Make the external SSO provider fail or become unreachable
Trigger a Procol login through SSO and verify the failure handling, including that the native-login fallback is caused by the failed SSO attempt and that no attempt is silently dropped
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure inbound SAML 2.0 integration INT-003 with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping; Make the external SSO provider fail or become unreachable; Trigger a Procol login through SSO and verify the failure handling, including that the native-login fallback is caused by the failed SSO attempt and that no attempt is silently dropped

args.need: configure inbound SAML 2.0 integration INT-003, make the external SSO provider fail or become unreachable, attempt login on Procol, and leave the browser on the resulting native-login fallback screen

steps.note: The tester must perform the tenant integration setup, external failure simulation, and login trigger that no catalog step can execute.
Checks for the known Procol-native login control after the tester reports the failed SSO attempt.
